title: TRAIN ANIMATION FIXES & DISPATCH LOGS
message: Key stability improvements for train movement rendering and new in-app system update logs.
points: 🚂 Smooth Train Animations: Fixed visual stuttering and frozen train movement frames across all tracks.
📜 System Update Logs: Added the 'What's New & Updates' dialog to track patch notes and new features in real time.
⚡ Dispatch Terminal Stability: Performance enhancements and UI optimizations across all station hubs.
